Sodass and So ... Dass: German B2 Result Clauses

Study four German examples with English meanings, then try four questions and check the explained answers.

B2 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Understand the rule

Sodass introduces a consequence: Es schneite stark, sodass die Straße gesperrt wurde. So dass is also a valid spelling of this conjunction. A different distribution places so with an adjective or adverb in the main clause and dass before the result: Es war so kalt, dass der See zufror.

Common mistake to avoid

Do not mark so dass as automatically wrong: both spellings of the result conjunction are accepted. In so kalt, dass, the two words belong to different clause positions.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Pay attention to the exact article, verb position or ending described in the rule.

Worked example 1Es schneite stark, sodass die Straße gesperrt wurde.It snowed heavily, so the road was closed.
Worked example 2Der Raum war so voll, dass wir draußen warten mussten.The room was so full that we had to wait outside.
Worked example 3Sie sprach deutlich, sodass alle sie verstanden.She spoke clearly, so everyone understood her.
Worked example 4Er lief so schnell, dass ich nicht mithalten konnte.He ran so fast that I could not keep up.

Practice: fill in the gaps

Use the spelling requested by the cue, or fill in the degree word so or the conjunction dass. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Question 1. Der Akku war leer, ___ das Gerät ausging. (one-word result conjunction)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: sodass

Sodass introduces the consequence; so dass is also a valid spelling outside this one-word task.

Question 2. Das Wasser war ___ kalt, dass niemand schwimmen wollte.

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: so

So intensifies kalt before the dass result clause.

Question 3. Die Musik war so laut, ___ wir das Telefon nicht hörten.

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: dass

The result clause after the degree phrase starts with dass.

Question 4. Es wurde dunkel, ___ wir das Licht einschalteten. (one-word result conjunction)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: sodass

The second event is presented as a consequence.

Revise it so it sticks

Return to this lesson tomorrow and complete the four gaps without looking at the rule. Then write two of your own sentences using today's pattern. Check whether the subject, case and verb position match the explanation.
